recordKind: Reproduction design specification, not a verbatim API transcript
commonPrompt: Identity-preserving production transparent 4x4 game sprite sheet. Reference 1 is the original playable hero actions; reference 2 is its old evolved form. Preserve original cartoon face and large-head short-body proportions. Large readable surfaces, strong outlines, saturated colors; not realistic. Exactly 16 full-body poses: idle, walk, attack, standing cast, four frames each. Elevated three-quarter view facing right, consistent size, feet grounded, complete weapon inside each frame with clear gutters. True RGBA transparent background, no floor, shadows, text, grid, badges or separate projectiles.

dwarf.identity: Short stout, oversized dark helmet, bright orange two-part braided beard, broad torso and short legs.
dwarf.awakened: Silver-steel armor, turquoise runes, short dark teal cloak, broad pauldrons and square hammer.
dwarf.transcendent: Black and antique-gold fortress armor, garnet short cape and tabard, orange rune square hammer.

goblin.identity: Yellow-green skin, large pointed ears, oversized head, hooked nose, round cyan goggles over eyes, leather cap, short legs and round boots.
goblin.awakened: Brown workshop coat, copper-steel shoulders, twin cyan tanks, chunky wrench.
goblin.transcendent: Brass and dark-steel power armor, orange chest furnace, twin pistons, boots and wrench; clearly a goblin, not a robot.
